name: CH4_LEAKAGE_METHOD
description:
Controls the CH4 leakage and venting method used across all 14 NG supply chain stage processes. Edit this value in openLCA to switch all processes simultaneously.

SET TO 1 — BU/TD Hybrid method (GREET default):
Combines bottom-up direct measurement data with EPA Greenhouse Gas Inventory (GHGI) top-down estimates. This is the GREET default and generally produces higher leakage rates, particularly at Production (~1.68x higher than BU) and gathering and boosting (~1.13x higher). Recommended for consistency with published GREET results. Source: GREET Inputs tab, cols K/L/M, rows 133-138.

SET TO 2 — Bottom-Up only method:
Uses direct measurement-based leakage rates only, without GHGI top-down adjustment. Produces lower system-wide leakage estimates. Use when comparing against measurement-based inventory studies or when EPA GHGI top-down data is not appropriate for the study context. Source: GREET Inputs tab, cols N/O/P, rows 133-138.

Note: Distribution stage values are identical between the two methods (GREET assigns the same rate regardless of method at this stage). Current value: 1 (BU/TD Hybrid). Reference: Burnham et al. (2025), ANL-25/18, Section 3.2.
